subject: remove alignment check on aarch64
perf_evidence: Commit removes an AArch64 alignment check because unaligned reads are fast on that target.
change_summary: Changes AArch64 read/alignment selection in XXH32, XXH64 and XXH3.

units.name: public XXH32/XXH64/XXH3 fixed-length AArch64 matrix
units.evidence: All 22 public fixed-length targets, with symbolic input bytes and pointer alignment, pass Alive2 in both directions on the AArch64 build.

units.name: x86 control with the same 22 public fixed-length cases
units.evidence: All 22 x86 control targets also pass both directions.

notes: Input content and alignment are symbolic but lengths are a finite matrix, not every possible length or build configuration. The target functions contain the hash computation rather than relying on unchanged opaque XXH calls.
